BiblicalUsage: Hazo is a son of Nahor by his wife Milcah, named among the eight children Milcah bore, and his brother Chesed is named beside him. He is a nephew of Abraham, and his name means vision.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hazo matters because his family is the family God chose Abraham out of. Nahor's sons are named so that we can see the kin Abraham left behind.
